vsl_script.text:
ROUTER VSL (/vsl, start here). Target length about 12 minutes, an epiphany bridge: the founders' own story from doing everything by hand to an autonomous operating system, then pick the one that's you. Adon and CC on camera, landscape, eye level, quiet room. Oasis Studio adds captions, b-roll, the screen recordings named below and the OASIS end card.
Rule for the whole video: the story is yours, told in your own words with real details only. This script gives the structure and the factual lines (what OASIS is, the four paths, the prices). Lines in square brackets are prompts for you, not words to read. Say no number, result or client story that is not on a page.

[BEAT 1. HOOK, 0:00 to 0:30]
[CC or Adon: open on one real moment from before OASIS ran itself, when you were doing everything by hand. Where were you, what time was it, what slipped through. One moment, told plainly.]

[BEAT 2. WHO THIS IS FOR, AND WHO IT IS NOT FOR, 0:30 to 1:30]
On camera: If you run a business and you are the one holding every follow-up, booking and handoff in your head, this is for you. Whether you are just starting, running a service business, building for clients, or running a larger operation, there is a path for you at the end of this video.
It is not for you if you are looking for a shortcut that needs no work from you. And if you are not ready for any of it, the free community is linked below the video.

[BEAT 3. THE STORY, 1:30 to 5:00]
[Adon and CC: tell the true story from that first moment to where OASIS is now. What you tried that did not work. The point where you stopped adding tools and started building one operating system. Keep it specific and true. No numbers unless you can show where they came from.]

[BEAT 4. WHY IT KEEPS HAPPENING, 5:00 to 6:30]
On camera: [Confirm this is true for you, or replace it.] The cause was never a missing app. It was that every follow-up, booking and handoff depended on one of us remembering it. Another tool did not change that. A system that does the remembering did.

[BEAT 5. WHAT WE BUILT, SHOWN IN THE COMMAND CENTER, 6:30 to 8:30]
Screen recording, synthetic data only: a test lead arrives, gets an answer, and a call lands in Schedule. Then a short tour of the back office screens.
Voice over: This is the OASIS Command Center, the system OASIS runs on.

[BEAT 6. THE FOUR PATHS, PRICES SAID OUT LOUD, 8:30 to 11:00]
On camera, matching each page word for word, in US dollars (CC 2026-10-16). Say only the prices CC has confirmed in the builder; the numbers below are Maven's recommendation until then.
PROTOCOL is for solo operators and DIY builders who keep rebuilding the same workflow: SOPs, prompts and blueprints written to be run in order, from $47 for a quick-win pack to $297 for the full suite.
COMMAND is for service businesses doing roughly $10K to $75K a month: Team, Growth, Clients and Money in one operating view. $497 a month on OS DIY, or set up for you on Turnkey at $2,500 plus $997 a month.
COMMUNITY is for builders and agencies: free on Telegram, with a weekly build room at $97 a month and founder mentorship at $2,500 a month, by application, when you want them.
FLEET is for mid-market and multi-location teams: it starts with an AI and security audit at $2,500, credited in full to the build.
Not sure which one is you? Start with the free AI audit. Conaugh reads every one personally.
Every monthly plan: cancel any time from your account, no cancellation fee. [CC: say this only once a self-serve cancel path is confirmed.]

[BEAT 7. PROOF, 11:00 to 11:30]
No permissioned examples are confirmed yet. Let the beat 5 recording be the proof: the product working.

[BEAT 8. CALL TO ACTION, 11:30 to 12:00]
On camera: Pick the one that's you below. One click, a couple of quick questions, and you open the page made for that path. Not ready for any of them? The free community is linked right below this video.
